Wait the template is substitution of hydroxyl with halogen, so forward reaction: starting material (precursor) has OH, product has halogen. In retrosynthesis, we go from product (with halogen) to precursor (with OH). So the product (target) contains a halogen where the precursor had OH. The two precursors we have: one has no halogen (just CO...), the other has a fluorine attached to a carbon (FC1...). So maybe the product is the combination where the fluorine is attached to the aromatic ring via O? Not sure.

But we just need to return the mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that does this transformation.
